method: Sheet-derived drawings preserve source RGB pixels, with only connected exterior background made transparent. Additional user-supplied regional drawings (Vicinity 35, old HandyDART, new HandyDART, updated LFSe) also have only their border-connected white background removed. Vancouver user-supplied drawings were also cleaned by removing only the border-connected light-grey background, then scaled onto transparent canvases with no redrawing.
